purpose: Control for the funnel's own similarity-based exclusions: dock a seeded random sample of rejected compounds under the identical fast-pass protocol and compare score distributions against the 5,000 that were kept.

arm_2d.population: biosynthetic pool entries that never reached the 8,000 2D-screen survivors; standardised and property-filtered here with the same MW<=700 / rotB<=10 rule

arm_3d.population: the 3,000 stage-2 survivors dropped by the 3D O3A refinement

docking_protocol: fast pass, identical to the expansion screen: 2 ETKDGv3 conformers, exhaustiveness 8, same receptor and box
